drafts.zu: Khetha izindawo ezigciniwe umsizi angazisebenzisa. Unganqamula ukuxhumana kokuthi Izilungiselelo.
drafts.st: Kgetha dibaka tse bolokilweng tseo mothusi a ka di sebedisang. O ka kgaola kgokahano ho Ditlhophiso.
drafts.ts: Hlawula tindhawu leti hlayisiweke leti mupfuni a nga ti tirhisaka. U nga tsema vuhlanganisi eka Swiyimiso.
drafts.ve: Nangani fhethu ho vhulungwaho hune muthusi a nga hu shumisa. Ni nga fhelisa vhuṱumanyi kha Nzudzanyo.

entries.source: Keep original site photos and PDFs with their source and import history.

drafts.zu: Gcina izithombe zokuqala zendawo nama-PDF kanye nomthombo wawo nomlando wokungeniswa kwawo.
drafts.st: Boloka dinepe tsa pele tsa sebaka le di-PDF hammoho le mohlodi wa tsona le nalane ya ho di kenya.
drafts.ts: Hlayisa swifaniso swa masungulo swa ndhawu ni ti-PDF swin’we ni xihlovo xa swona ni matimu ya ku swi nghenisa.
drafts.ve: Vhulungani zwifanyiso zwa u thoma zwa fhethu na dzi-PDF, khathihi na vhubvo hazwo na ḓivhazwakale ya u zwi dzhenisa.

entries.source: Review historical photo registration drafts without moving saved map features.

drafts.zu: Hlola okusalungiswa kokuqondanisa izithombe zakudala nemephu ngaphandle kokususa izinto ezigciniwe ezindaweni zazo.
drafts.st: Hlahloba meralo ya ho nyalanya dinepe tsa kgale le mmapa ntle le ho suthisa dintho tse bolokilweng mmapeng.
drafts.ts: Kambela mipfapfarhuto ya ku fambelanisa swifaniso swa khale ni mepe handle ko susa swilo leswi hlayisiweke emepeni.
drafts.ve: Ṱolani mvetamveto ya u livhanyisa zwifanyiso zwa kale na mapa, ni sa sudzulusi zwithu zwo vhulungwaho kha mapa.

entries.source: Review connected assistants, selected sites and imported originals.

drafts.zu: Hlola abasizi abaxhunyiwe, izindawo ezikhethiwe namafayela okuqala angenisiwe.
drafts.st: Hlahloba bathusi ba hoketsweng, dibaka tse kgethilweng le difaele tsa pele tse kentsweng.
drafts.ts: Kambela vapfuni lava hlanganisiweke, tindhawu leti hlawuriweke ni tifayela ta masungulo leti nghenisiweke.
drafts.ve: Ṱolani vhathusi vho ṱumanywaho, fhethu ho nangiwaho na faela dza u thoma dzo dzheniswaho.

drafts.st: Lekola mmapa wa hao o bolokilweng
drafts.ts: Kambela mepe wa wena lowu hlayisiweke

drafts.zu: Hlola yona leyo ndawo ngaphambi kokwamukela izinguquko zomsizi noma ukuqhathanisa isithombe sakudala.
drafts.st: Hlahloba sebaka sona seo pele o kenya diphetoho tsa mothusi kapa o bapisa senepe sa kgale.
drafts.ts: Kambela ndhawu yoleyo u nga si tirhisa mindzulamiso ya mupfuni kumbe ku pimanisa xifaniso xa khale.
drafts.ve: Ṱolani henefho fhethu musi ni sa athu shumisa tshanduko dza muthusi kana u vhambedza tshifanyiso tsha kale.
